scenarios.name: watchdog
scenarios.goal: Independently alert when disaster-recovery nodes A or B become unavailable.

acceptance_criteria.description: A unavailable produces A NODE DOWN ALERT.
B unavailable produces B NODE DOWN ALERT.
A and B unavailable leaves both node-level alerts observable.
Recovery restores the correct healthy state.

scenarios.name: api_release
scenarios.goal: Release a service API with health, authentication, and rollback verified.

acceptance_criteria.description: Authentication rejects invalid credentials and accepts valid credentials.
Rollback restores the previous stable release.

scenarios.name: database_migration
scenarios.goal: Migrate a schema without data loss and verify forward and rollback paths.

acceptance_criteria.description: Record counts and checksums match expected values.
Rollback restores the pre-migration schema and data.

scenarios.name: ci_pipeline
scenarios.goal: Create a CI pipeline that tests, builds, and publishes on the intended branch.

acceptance_criteria.description: Unit tests run and fail the pipeline on test failure.
Publish step runs only on the intended branch after tests pass.

scenarios.name: backup_restore
scenarios.goal: Verify a backup can be created, integrity-checked, and restored.

acceptance_criteria.description: Restore recreates the expected files and metadata.

scenarios.name: research_pipeline
scenarios.goal: Produce a reproducible analysis with data validation, model run, and exported results.

acceptance_criteria.description: Primary metrics are exported with provenance.
